clue.text: Place first and last letter next to a square

parts.note: PL is the standard abbreviation for place, as in street addresses
A and Z begin and end the alphabet

explanation.surface: Instructions for positioning letters beside a square, like a puzzle-setter's layout note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first and last letter' means of the alphabet, not of any clue word, so it gives A and Z.
explanation.definitionFit: A town's open public square is called by this Spanish-derived word, especially in America.

clue.text: Dropping unit from sky appears to get rotor damaged

indicators.note: a damaged rotor no longer holds its shape, so the letters of both words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A helicopter's rotor seems to have been damaged, perhaps during an airborne operation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damaged' rearranges APPEARS and ROTOR together.
explanation.definitionFit: Airborne soldiers who jump by parachute form a unit dropped from aircraft into battle.

clue.text: With one against playing back slow piece of music

parts.note: and means with, as in bread and butter
an anti is a person who is against something

indicators.note: back means the word for playing is read the other way round

parts.note: a show that is playing is on

explanation.surface: A musician with an opponent plays back a slow passage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one against' is a noun, an anti, a person opposed, not one letter plus a preposition; 'back' signals the reversal.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction or movement a little quicker than andante, still a gentle, unhurried tempo.

clue.text: Don't catch an STI that's going around Love Island

indicators.note: going around means the first pieces enclose the later ones

parts.note: VD, venereal disease, is an older name for a sexually transmitted infection
love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: Health advice for contestants on the dating show Love Island, where an infection is spreading.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's going around' puts O and I inside A plus VD. Love Island is a British reality dating show set in a villa.
explanation.definitionFit: To evade or steer clear of something is to escape catching it, like dodging a ball or a cold.

clue.text: Denial of strike from head: actual lines

indicators.note: to line something is to fill its inside, so the word for actual is lined with the strike

parts.note: real means actual
to butt is to strike with the head

explanation.surface: Someone denies headbutting, with the actual wording of the denial quoted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lines' looks like a noun but is the verb: REAL is lined with BUTT.
explanation.definitionFit: A counter-argument or refutation is a formal denial of a claim.

clue.text: European man, to stop itching, is trying once more

indicators.note: to stop a gap is to plug it, so these letters go into the word for itching

parts.note: raring, as in raring to go, means itching to do something
he is a man

explanation.surface: A European man tries again to stop an itch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to stop' means plug a gap; 'trying' is the courtroom sense, hearing a case.
explanation.definitionFit: A court case heard afresh is tried again, a retrial.

clue.text: See 11
Entertainer turning up at party, initially with tower of presents

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up reverses the word at
initially takes the opening letter of party

parts.note: Dancer is one of Santa's reindeer, which tow his sleigh of gifts

explanation.surface: An entertainer arrives at a party with a pile of presents.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tower' is someone who tows, not a tall building: Santa's reindeer Dancer.
explanation.definitionFit: A stage performer who dances in metal-tipped shoes is a kind of entertainer.

clue.text: Sailing all over the place

definitions.meaning: out on the ocean in a ship

explanation.surface: Sailing everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Out on the ocean, and figuratively lost or baffled, both share this short phrase.

clue.text: One treats people in waves from terrible apartheid riots

indicators.note: terrible signals that the letters are wrecked into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone treats people caught up in waves of violence from apartheid riots.
explanation.walkthrough: 'waves' looks like waves of rioting but means radiation used in cancer treatment.
explanation.definitionFit: A clinician who treats cancer patients with beams of radiation treats them with waves.

clue.text: They hit bars playing music from 10: only sip shot when hammered

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral ten

indicators.note: hammered means drunk, suggesting the letters stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: Drinkers out from ten hit the bars, only taking sips of shots when drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hit bars' is not a pub crawl: they strike wooden bars with mallets. 'hammered' is the anagram signal, giving YLOPHONISTS.
explanation.definitionFit: Percussionists who strike the tuned wooden bars of a mallet instrument make music.

clue.text: Hopeless with pitch that's firm? Australia following on edgily at first

indicators.note: in an across clue on means placed after

parts.note: toned muscles are firm

indicators.note: at first takes the opening letter of edgily

parts.note: A is the international vehicle code for Australia
F is the abbreviation for following, as in page references

explanation.surface: A cricket-flavoured scene: Australia batting on edgily on a firm pitch, hopeless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pitch' suggests a cricket ground but means musical pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone unable to tell musical notes apart is hopeless at hearing pitch.

clue.text: Flyer complained after vacation about flying Ryanair across Belgium

indicators.note: about means the outer letters go round everything else
vacating a word empties it, leaving only its outer letters
across means the Ryanair letters lie on either side of the Belgium letter
flying jumbles the letters of the airline's name

parts.note: B is the international vehicle code for Belgium

explanation.surface: A passenger complained after a holiday about a Ryanair flight over Belgium.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vacation' is not a holiday but emptying a word. 'flying' gives ANARYIR, 'across' sets B within it as ANARYBIR, and 'about' wraps the emptied word round the lot.
explanation.definitionFit: A small yellow songbird kept as a pet is something that flies.

clue.text: Reacting from chemistry: one courting with hug and kiss at the start

indicators.note: at the start places the hug and kiss before the other pieces

parts.note: O and X stand for a hug and a kiss at the end of a letter
I is the Roman numeral one
dating means courting

explanation.surface: A romantic scene: someone courting, with hugs and kisses from the start, and chemistry between them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chemistry' looks like romantic spark but is the science of reactions.
explanation.definitionFit: Combining with oxygen, as when iron rusts, is a chemical reaction.

clue.text: Horrible injury from fighting? Men split

parts.note: ABH, actual bodily harm, is the English legal term for injury from an assault
OR, other ranks, are soldiers who are not officers
rent means torn or split

explanation.surface: A horrible injury in a brawl: men split open.
explanation.walkthrough: ABH is actual bodily harm, an assault charge in English law.
explanation.definitionFit: Something repugnant or loathsome is horrible.

clue.text: Driver might go through these short tee positions following golf ace

indicators.note: following puts the tee and positions after the golf ace letters

parts.note: G is golf in the NATO phonetic alphabet
A is the abbreviation for ace in cards

indicators.note: short means the word tee loses its last letter

parts.note: posts are positions or jobs

explanation.surface: Golf talk: a driver club, tee positions and an ace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Driver' is a golf club in the surface but a motorist in the definition, driving between the posts of an entrance.
explanation.definitionFit: The pair of uprights an entrance gate hangs on is what a car passes between.

clue.text: Do work in part of Africa

parts.note: to do someone is to swindle or con them
a machine that works goes

explanation.surface: A suggestion to go and work somewhere in Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Do' is the slang verb for cheat, not a helping verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A Central African republic, and its neighbour the Democratic Republic, share this name and river.

clue.text: North America to deploy soldiers — they make one sick!

parts.note: to deploy something is to use it
soldier ants are a caste of ant, so ants can be soldiers

explanation.surface: America sends in its troops, and the speaker is sickened by them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'soldiers' are ants here, from soldier ants.
explanation.definitionFit: Substances that bring on nausea, emetics, cause vomiting.

clue.text: Dog muck outside of church

parts.note: poo is muck, dung

indicators.note: outside of takes the outer letters of church

explanation.surface: Dog mess left outside a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside of' looks like a place but picks the first and last letters of church.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal word for a pet hound or mutt.

clue.text: Managed hospital: sick suffer

parts.note: to have got to do something is to have managed it
H is the abbreviation for hospital on maps and signs
feeling rough means feeling sick

explanation.surface: A report on a managed hospital where the sick suffer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Managed' looks like run by managers but means succeeded, giving GOT.
explanation.definitionFit: To undergo or endure an ordeal is to suffer it.

clue.text: Hand back profit

definitions.meaning: give back, restore to its owner
yield or gain on an investment

explanation.surface: Give back the gains.
explanation.definitionFit: Both restoring something and the yield made on money share this one word.

clue.text: Now daughter and adult play outside

indicators.note: outside means the toying word wraps round the other letters

parts.note: to toy with something is to play with it
D is the abbreviation for daughter in family trees
A is the film certificate for adult

explanation.surface: A parent tells daughter and adult to play outside now.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' puts TOY around D and A.
explanation.definitionFit: The present day, this very moment in time.

clue.text: Irish rascal spotted pinching a record by Prince

indicators.note: pinching means the word for spotted grabs the other letters inside it

parts.note: seen means spotted

indicators.note: by means set beside, here with the prince letter first

parts.note: LP, long player, is a vinyl album record

explanation.surface: An Irish rogue caught stealing a Prince album.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prince' looks like the musician but is the abbreviation P.
explanation.definitionFit: An Irish word for a rogue or good-for-nothing, originally a migrant labourer.

clue.text: Tramp's wearing tight cap

indicators.note: wearing means the setter's words are dressed in the word for tight

parts.note: lit and tight are both slang for drunk
Tramp is the setter, so Tramp's means Tramp is, I'M

explanation.surface: A tramp wearing a tight cap.
explanation.walkthrough: Tramp is this puzzle's setter, so 'Tramp's' means I am.
explanation.definitionFit: A maximum or ceiling, as in a spending cap.

clue.text: Put back model in collection

indicators.note: in puts the model letter inside the collection word

parts.note: a set is a collection
the Model T was Ford's early mass-produced car

explanation.surface: Return a model to its place in a collection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put back' is the proofreader's mark restoring a deleted word.
explanation.definitionFit: A proofreading instruction meaning let it stand, restoring text that was crossed out.

clue.text: Start to miss EastEnders: ITV breaks with these?

definitions.text: Start to miss EastEnders: ITV breaks with these?

indicators.note: breaks means the letters are smashed up and reassembled
start to takes the first letter of miss

explanation.surface: A grumble that a viewer misses EastEnders, and ITV's programmes are broken up with these.
explanation.walkthrough: EastEnders is a BBC soap, so it has none; ITV is Britain's main commercial channel, whose shows break for them. 'breaks' rearranges M with EASTENDERS ITV.
explanation.definitionFit: Commercial channels interrupt programmes with paid promotions for products.

clue.text: It makes it hard to go in court to describe barren years' sex lives

definitions.text: It makes it hard to go

indicators.note: to describe a circle is to draw round it, so the court letters surround the next pair
barren means emptied of its middle, leaving the outer letters of years

parts.note: it is slang for sex
is means lives or exists

explanation.surface: A court hears testimony about years of barren sex lives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'barren' empties a word to its outer letters, and 'to describe' means draw round, as with a circle.
explanation.definitionFit: A bladder inflammation makes urinating painful, so going to the toilet is hard.

clue.text: Screens international games

definitions.meaning: checks or examines, as in medical screening
matches between national sides in cricket or rugby

explanation.surface: Screens showing international games.
explanation.definitionFit: Examinations and cricket or rugby internationals share this one word.
